summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone wave of 112 UAVs, with Ukraine downing 97 but suffering deadly strikes on Dnipro railway station (13 killed) and a Kremenchuk apartment building (2 killed, 11 injured). Ukrainian drones struck Moscow, Volgograd, and Bashkortostan, while Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske in Donetsk region. A localized ceasefire in Oleshky holds for 54 hours with humanitarian access.
key_points: Russia launched 112 strike UAVs (40 jet-powered Shaheds) overnight Oct 28-29; Ukraine shot down/suppressed 97, with 7 hits and 5 debris sites. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)
Russian jet UAV hit Dnipro railway station platform killing 13 civilians and injuring 13; three of four UAVs intercepted. (Source: @kpszsu/91228)
Russian UAV struck Kremenchuk apartment building killing 2 and injuring 11 including 3 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84986)
Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow, Volgograd (Marinovka airfield fire), and Bashkortostan (chemical complex); Moscow airports restricted. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske in Donetsk region per DeepState maps. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23936, @DeepStateUA/23937)
Oleshky ceasefire holds 54 hours; humanitarian convoy planned, US journalists to monitor. (Source: @UkraineNow/84968)
Poland to deliver two MiG-29s; EU proposes €21.3B SAFE program for joint defense procurement. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23946, @DeepStateUA/23947)
Ballistic missile threat (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) reported from Kursk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77607)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone wave of 112 UAVs, with Ukraine downing 97 but suffering deadly strikes on Dnipro railway station (13 killed) and a Kremenchuk apartment building (2 killed, 11 injured). Ukrainian drones struck Moscow, Volgograd, and Bashkortostan, while Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske in Donetsk region. A localized ceasefire in Oleshky holds for 54 hours with humanitarian access.

points: Ukrainian air defense shot down/suppressed 97 of 112 Russian UAVs (including 30 jet-powered Shaheds) overnight Oct 28-29, with hits recorded at 7 locations and debris at 5. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)

Ukrainian drones struck Moscow and Moscow region overnight, causing flight restrictions at three airports and diverting two flights from Turkey; fire reported at Marinovka military airfield in Volgograd region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Ukrainian forces attacked Bashkortostan, potentially hitting Bashkir Soda Company in Sterlitamak, a major chemical complex storing aviation fuel. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Ukraine to receive two MiG-29 fighters from Poland as part of ~€50M aid package including 155/152mm artillery ammo, 20x102mm rounds for F-16, and Piorun MANPADS missiles. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23946)

EU Commission proposed €21.3B under SAFE program for joint defense procurement with Ukraine, prioritizing air defense, missiles, drones, counter-UAV, ammunition; total SAFE envelope €150B. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23947)

Russia launched 112 strike UAVs (40 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, Parody decoys) from Orel, Millerovo, occupied Donetsk overnight Oct 28-29; 97 destroyed/suppressed, ~7 still airborne. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)
Russian jet UAV hit Dnipro railway station platform at ~11:00 Oct 29, killing 13 civilians and injuring 13; three of four UAVs intercepted. (Source: @kpszsu/91228)
Russian UAV struck apartment building in Kremenchuk, Poltava region, killing 2 and injuring 11 (including 3 children), causing large fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/84986)
Russian drone attacked animal shelter in Chernihiv, injuring 3 women, killing 1 dog, injuring 3 cats and 1 dog. (Source: @UkraineNow/84954)
Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske (Donetsk region) and Maiske per DeepState map updates Oct 29. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23936, @DeepStateUA/23937)
Ballistic missile threat (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) reported from Kursk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77607)
Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka and Luhivske in Donetsk region per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23936)
Russian forces advanced near Maiske in Donetsk region per subsequent DeepState update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23937)
Russian strike UAVs observed moving toward Barvinkove (Kharkiv region) from Donetsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/91242)
Russian UAV targeted Lozova, Kharkiv region from southeast. (Source: @kpszsu/91214)

Multiple Russian jet UAVs (Shaheds, Banderyol S8000) tracked across Chernihiv region: past Snovsk, Bobrovytsia, Nizhyn, Kulikivka, Kozelets, Berezna, heading toward Kyiv and Poltava regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/126841, @eRadarrua/126835, @kpszsu/91217, @eRadarrua/126869)
Russian Geran-5 rocket launched from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77603)
Ballistic missile launch threat (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) from Kursk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77607)
Russian UAV strike on Chernihiv city killed 2, injured 2, caused fire in shops. (Source: @UkraineNow/84983)
Kherson experiencing second day of "silence regime" with civilians returning to streets, markets, cafes; communal workers operating without mobile fire group cover. (Source: @UkraineNow/84956)
Oleshky ceasefire holding 54 hours; humanitarian convoy planned, four US journalists to observe as neutral monitors. (Source: @UkraineNow/84968)
Russian strike UAVs active in Zaporizhzhia region: targeting Vilniansk toward Zaporizhzhia city, and Balabyne. (Source: @kpszsu/91230, @kpszsu/91239)

Overnight Oct 28-29: Russia launched 112 UAVs (40 jet Shaheds, Gerbera, Parody) from Orel, Millerovo, occupied Donetsk; Ukraine shot down/suppressed 97 (30 jet), ~7 still airborne; 7 hit locations, 5 debris falls. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)

Jet-powered Shahed UAVs widely reported: over Kyiv (northeast), past Makariv, Pereyaslav, Smila, Kozelets, Berezna, Magdalynivka, Solone, Slavhorod, Velyka Bahachka, Lysianka; Geran-5 rockets on Zhytomyr, Rivne, Chernihiv.
